api:
OV.Battle.debrief(B, ctx?) — ctx now also takes:
  captureRoom?: int  (free containment places). Only the first captureRoom entries of deb.captured score as captures (2×value, or SCORE_CAPTURE_KNOWN once interrogated). The rest are added to the 'bs.debrief.aliensKilled' line (value) and to deb.kills. deb.captured still lists every capture, in the same order. If captureRoom is omitted, all captures count (skirmish behaviour is unchanged).
  terrorFloor?: int  (points for an ignored terror site). When mission.kind==='terror', the result is not 'win' and terrorFloor > civilians killed by aliens × civValue, a line {key: OV.Battle.TERROR_ABANDONED_KEY, n:1, points: −(terrorFloor − byAliens×civValue)} is added and included in deb.score.
OV.Battle.TERROR_ABANDONED_KEY = 'cp.mr.alienTerror.one' (existing pt-PT text «Ataque terrorista sem resposta»).
OV.Campaign.finishMission(G, B), step 1: now calls Battle.debrief(B, {researched, captureRoom: containmentRoom(base) or 0, terrorFloor: site ? Missions.expiredPoints(G) : 0}). Step 3 uses the same room value. The model shape is unchanged.
Data: OV.Data.items.medikit.research is now null, and so is its topic. The Medi-Kit can be used, and its Ufopaedia item article is always open. The 'medikit' research topic still exists and unlocks manufacture (manufacture.medikit.requires === 'medikit').
tools/campaign_bot.js: engineer allocation skips unpaid stalled production orders (p.stalled && !p.paid).
summary:
Fixed all 3 round-2 sim/data findings in r2_fixS.json at the root. Each one has a regression check in the new file tools/tests/sim_persona_r2.test.js (4 tests).

1. FIXED (major): token terror response. A turn-1 abort used to cost only civilians × 30 (about −240), while ignoring the site cost −500 or −1000, so aborting was the dominant play. The root cause was in Battle.debrief. Campaign.finishMission now passes terrorFloor = Missions.expiredPoints(G). A lost or aborted terror battle now costs at least that much in civilians, through a new report line «Ataque terrorista sem resposta» that covers the shortfall. The site is still removed after any battle (OpenXcom), so there is no double penalty, and kills made before aborting still score. The persona flow re-run through the campaign gives month 0 → −500 for every seed and months 2 and 4 → −1000 (it was −240). Test: campaign abort on turn 1 at months 0 and 2 gives a score ≤ −expiredPoints, the line is present, the site is gone and nothing is counted twice. It also checks there is no line on a win or in a skirmish, and that the line only covers the shortfall.

2. FIXED (major): unusable starting Medi-Kits. The root cause was data: items.medikit had research:'medikit', which gated use in battle. DESIGN §3.15 already says the topic only unlocks manufacture, and OpenXcom's Medi-Kit has no `requires`. I removed the gate, so the kits work from day 1. That also fixes «POR INVESTIGAR» in the equip screen, the AI gate and the meaning of the briefing warning, because every UI gate reads d.research. The research topic and the manufacture requirement are unchanged. Test: real campaign → startMission with researched [] → the medic's starting kit validates heal and stim. The pinned value in data_items_units was updated.

3. FIXED (minor): captures without containment scored 2×value. Battle.debrief now takes captureRoom from finishMission. Captures that do not fit count as killed (value, deb.kills, stats.aliensKilled) instead of «capturados vivos». Test: the same landed battle without and with containment, checking lines, points and stats.

Side effect: with usable kits, the campaign-bot sweep first showed Recruta timeouts. I traced them to a bot bug: a Power Suit order stalled by full storage held all 20 engineers while the paid Avenger had none. I fixed it in tools/campaign_bot.js by skipping unpaid stalled orders. Sweep over seeds 1–12, before → after: Recruta 11/12 → 11/12, Veterano 6/12 → 6/12, no council defeats. Recorded in CAMPAIGN_API §11.8.

Docs: CAMPAIGN_API §1.13, finishMission steps 1 and 3, the new §11.8, and the DESIGN §22 deviations plus the Medi-Kit note.

Checks: node tools/test.js --strict --i18n is green (677/0; the only missing key reported is the deliberate test key nao.existe.x). Earlier runs had transient failures in shell_persona_r1 and campaign_ui_texts from the other fixers' in-progress UI keys; both now pass. qa/full_campaign.mjs completed without errors. Browser check on a random port, server killed afterwards: the campaign debrief for a terror abort and for a capture without containment at 1440×900, 1024×576, iPad 834×1194 and 1194×834 touch. There is no ⟦missing⟧ text and no console errors, and the line shows as «Ataque terrorista sem resposta ×1 −260», total −500. Screenshots are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/ui4/r2s/.
deviations: The abandoned-terror report line reuses the existing key 'cp.mr.alienTerror.one' («Ataque terrorista sem resposta»), exposed as OV.Battle.TERROR_ABANDONED_KEY. I own no i18n file, and the line must never show ⟦missing⟧.

Of the persona's suggested fixes I chose: for the terror abort, max(civilians × value, expiredPoints) with a visible shortfall line, not a flat extra penalty and not keeping the site alive (that would bring back the double penalty that §11.5 removed). For the Medi-Kit, option (a), usable without research, which matches DESIGN §3.15 «manuf.». For captures, captureRoom passed into the debrief, so the report lines and the score agree.
Medi-Kit item: topic dropped too, not only research, so its Ufopaedia article is always open (itemAlways = !research && !topic). The player owns kits from day 1.
tools/campaign_bot.js changed (engineers skip unpaid stalled orders). This was not a persona finding; it was needed because the Medi-Kit change exposed it in the sweep.
open_issues: Optional, for the owner of js/i18n/pt-PT.battle.js: a dedicated debrief text. Add `'bs.debrief.terrorAbandoned': 'Local de terror abandonado',` to pt-PT.battle.js, then in js/sim/battle/battle.js change `const TERROR_ABANDONED_KEY = 'cp.mr.alienTerror.one';` to `const TERROR_ABANDONED_KEY = 'bs.debrief.terrorAbandoned';`. The tests use the constant, so nothing else changes.

Optional, for the owner of js/i18n/pt-PT.geoui.js: the terror popup stake text 'geo.ev.terrorSite.stakes' could say that abandoning the battle costs the same, e.g. «Sem resposta (ou abandonando a batalha), o conselho perde a confiança: −{points} pontos.»

The campaign-bot sweep over 12 seeds per difficulty is still noisy: Veterano wins 6/12 before and after, and Cydonia swings 40–100 % between seed sets. The remaining Veterano gap is in the bot's alien-base and finale battles, as documented in §11.6 and §11.7, not in these changes.
